newsitem.title: USA: PECO trims Pa. Peach Bottom 2 output - NRC.
newsitem.headline: PECO trims Pa. Peach Bottom 2 output - NRC.

text.p: PECO Energy Co trimmed power output at the 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom 2 nuclear power unit in Delta, Pa., late Tuesday for adjustment of its control rods, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
Peach Bottom 2's electricity production was reduced to 76 percent of capacity from 100 percent, NRC said in its daily status report.
It is standard practice to shift the pattern of a reactor's control rods following an outage.
Peach Bottom was automatically shut Tuesday Oct 15 due to an electrical problem with the turbine generator.
The neighboring Peach Bottom 1, also rated at 1,100 MW, was operating at full power, NRC said.
PECO and Public Service Enterprise Group Inc each have 42.5 percent interests in the Peach Bottom units, with Atlantic Energy Inc and Delmarva Power and Light Co each owning 7.5 percent.
About 37.5 percent of the electricity output in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool comes from nuclear generation.
